title: Skitracks Metric1 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skitracks:metric1
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often skitracks metric1 (1) events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on skitracks metric1 (1) events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates how often your skitracks metric1 (1) exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
